classification.difficultyReason: Reference angles are given by arcs. The student must read each as a directed angle in its quadrant and apply the sign pattern. This is more than p40-q9 but less than the directed-angle reading in p41-q10.

content.prompt:
The points $P,Q,R,S$ are on the unit circle. $O$ is the origin.
Find the exact coordinates of $P,Q,R,S$.

answer.worked:
On the unit circle, coordinates are $(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$ for the directed angle $\theta$ from the positive $x$-axis. Read each directed angle from the diagram.
$$\begin{align*}P&:\ 180^\circ-30^\circ=150^\circ\\P&=(\cos150^\circ,\sin150^\circ)=\left(-\frac{\sqrt3}{2},\frac12\right)\\Q&:\ 270^\circ-30^\circ=240^\circ\\Q&=(\cos240^\circ,\sin240^\circ)=\left(-\frac12,-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)\\R&:\ 360^\circ-30^\circ=330^\circ\\R&=(\cos330^\circ,\sin330^\circ)=\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2},-\frac12\right)\\S&:\ 90^\circ-45^\circ=45^\circ\\S&=(\cos45^\circ,\sin45^\circ)=\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt2},\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\right)\end{align*}$$
